# CDL Entry Level Driver Training (ELDT): Hazmat and Tanker (X) Endorsement

> 5-hour online entry-level driver training theory that combines the Hazardous Materials (H) and Tank Vehicle (N) endorsement requirements to qualify drivers for the CDL X endorsement, under FMCSA and DOT regulations including 49 CFR Parts 171-180. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com), listed on the FMCSA Training Provider Registry.

## Key facts
- X endorsement = H (hazardous materials) + N (tank vehicle): transporting hazardous liquids and gases in bulk tanks
- Duration: 5 hours; 5 modules, 14 lessons, final exam (80% to pass)
- Credits: 0.5 CEU
- Price: $129.99 per person; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7
- Reporting: records sent to the FMCSA Training Provider Registry on passing
- Also required: H and N knowledge tests; TSA background check (identity verification, fingerprinting, security threat assessment); federal and state age, medical and eligibility requirements
- State acceptance: every state except Washington
- Prerequisite: valid CDL (Class A, B or C)

## Modules
1. Hazmat Basic Requirements and Communication
2. Safe Transportation Practices (tunnels and rail crossings, loading, bulk packages, tank vehicle operation and inspection)
3. Emergency Preparedness and Response
4. Pre-Trip and Operational Considerations (engine and fueling, tires)
5. Planning and Permits (route planning, hazmat safety permits)
